finalRevisions.description: Final Studio changes block preset selection during custom-icon preparation/upload, reject CSS animation after escape normalization, preserve explicit SVG intrinsic aspect, and use FileReader data URLs so rasterization works under the existing CSP. Focused helper tests, final typecheck, affected lint and a replacement production build cover final code; browser verification is recorded separately.

limitations: Build emits tool-level module.register deprecation, greater-than-500kB chunk guidance and Vinext route-classification notice.
Automated checks do not establish measured performance changes or Safari visual behavior.
The full suite predates the narrowly scoped final Studio fixes; focused final checks and separate browser evidence cover those revisions.

intermediateBrowserFailure.finding: Real browser upload failed because existing CSP excludes blob: image URLs.
intermediateBrowserFailure.fix: Conversion helper now reads PNG/SVG input as a data URL; CSP is unchanged.
intermediateBrowserFailure.browserRetest: Passed: four actual SVG/PNG uploads, rejection paths, preset restoration and room/reader rendering; see browser-uploads.json and README.md.
